title: Python Basics: Strings and Helpers
learningGoals: Write a function that transforms a string.
Use Python string methods in a controlled way.
Check normal and edge-case test inputs.

teachingScript.teacherLine: Strings are pieces of text. A helper function can clean or transform that text for us.
teachingScript.boardAction: Write a sample word and show how lower() changes it.
teachingScript.checkpointPrompt: What should happen to HELLO if we want a lowercase answer?
teachingScript.microPractice: Predict the lowercase form of Python.

teachingScript.teacherLine: A helper function can take one string and return a cleaned version without changing the original prompt.
teachingScript.boardAction: Write def make_slug(text): return text.lower().replace(" ", "-") on the board.
teachingScript.checkpointPrompt: If the input is Hello World, what should the function return?
teachingScript.microPractice: Predict the output for Data Science.

teachingScript.teacherLine: A good coder also tests short inputs, repeated spaces, and already-clean values.
teachingScript.boardAction: List a normal case, an already-lowercase case, and a one-word case.
teachingScript.checkpointPrompt: Which test would prove the function handles a single word safely?
teachingScript.microPractice: Suggest one extra test for a lowercase phrase.

coreIdeas: String methods can transform text step by step.
A helper function should return a predictable result.
Tests should include both normal and simple edge cases.

workedExamples.question: Write a function that turns a phrase into lowercase hyphen-separated text.
workedExamples.method: Lowercase the string first, then replace spaces with hyphens.

starterPractice: Predict the lowercase form of HELLO.
Turn two words into one hyphenated phrase.
Check what happens with a single lowercase word.

questionPool.questionText: Which Python string method turns HELLO into hello?
questionPool.hint: Choose the method that makes letters lowercase.
questionPool.solution: lower() converts uppercase letters to lowercase.

questionPool.questionText: Write a Python function make_slug(text) that returns the lowercase version of text with spaces replaced by hyphens.

rubric.success: Function returns lowercase text with spaces changed to hyphens.
rubric.commonMistake: Calling print instead of return, or forgetting lower().

questionPool.questionText: Complete the expected outputs: make_slug("Hello World") -> __ ; make_slug("Python") -> __ .
questionPool.hint: Lowercase both answers and add a hyphen for the two-word phrase.
questionPool.solution: The outputs are hello-world and python.
